name: J&W Pro Partner Portal
oneLiner: A wholesale portal where GTA gyms, trainers, clinics, supplement shops and teams apply in two minutes, get tiered case pricing on Meal Butler meals and butcher cases, and receive standing weekly drops on J&W's own routes.
headline: Gyms, trainers and clinics already send people to J&W by word of mouth, and a real partner program turns that into standing weekly case orders that fill the plant and make the routes denser, with almost all of the volume new to J&W.
focus: B2B wholesale portal for gyms, clinics, trainers, shops
mechanism: J&W adds a partner page, a 2-minute application and a login-gated price list for six groups: gyms and CrossFit boxes, trainers, physio/dietitian/weight-loss clinics, supplement shops, fight gyms, and teams and academies. Partners get Concept tier discounts off J&W's own web prices (Partner $150+/week: 15% off cooked, 5% off cases; Pro $300+: 20%/8% plus a loaned reach-in freezer and co-branded labels; Elite $600+: 25%/10%). Example: Jerk Chicken, Green Beans & Sweet Potato 6 oz is $14.99 online, $11.99 at Pro, so a gym selling at web price keeps $3.00 a meal; a 48-Meal Freezer Restock is $721.32 at web price and $577.06 at Pro. Butcher cases come at tier prices too: 4 kg Portioned Chicken Breast $92 to $84.64, Ontario Ground Turkey 10 x 1 lb $129 to $118.68, Premium Chicken Burgers 25-pack $35.50 to $32.66. Orders need 12 meals or one case, standing orders of $150+ drop free on the partner's GTA 1-4 route day, payment is by card for four orders then net-15, and every partner gets a member code (10% off a member's first online order, 5% back as J&W credit), with the DTC sales tracked but not counted here.

modelledOn.name: Icon Meals
modelledOn.short: US meal-prep plant selling wholesale to gyms, clinics, offices and teams
modelledOn.what: A cooked meal-prep plant with in-house meat processing that sells heat-and-eat meals wholesale to stores, gyms, weight-loss clinics, training centres and offices, from a few dozen meals to thousands a week (company claim). It runs a wholesale login and a partner-logo wall. We borrow the page order (proof, segments, plant story, shoppable grid with macros and steppers), the audience router, the low per-order minimum and the coach shared-cart idea. Ideas only, no copy.
modelledOn.proof: Over US$14M revenue in 2023 with 75 staff (Garage Gym Reviews). UFC took an equity stake in 2021, citing 56% annualised growth since 2014. Claims 12M+ meals sold and thousands of wholesale partners; Shopify catalogue updated Oct 16 2026. Caveats: its Apply buttons link to the homepage, there is no form or price list, the wholesale login is the standard Shopify login, and Trustpilot shows 1.7/5 from 980 reviews with every review from May to Oct 2026 at 1-star.
modelledOn.jwEdge: An Ontario-inspected plant with in-house butchery since 2008, family wholesale roots back to 1973 and a 2026 federal chicken TRQ processor quota. Lower prices: cooked chicken C$16.72-19.96/lb vs Icon's C$21.58/lb, and a comparable bowl about C$10 vs C$18.63. Food arrives frozen on J&W's own vans, not on dry ice. J&W has 4.8 stars from 611 Google reviews. And J&W can ship what Icon never built: a working application, a tiered price list and net terms.

mathYear1: November 2026 is the build (price list, agreement, app, labels) and first drops go out in December 2026. Active accounts, net of ~2.5%/month churn, ramp 4 (Dec), 8, 12, 16, 19, 22, 24, 26, 28, 31, 34 (Oct 2027) = 224 account-months x 4.33 weeks = 970 account-weeks x $260 average weekly order (new accounts start near $180, freezer accounts reach $400+) = $252,200 gross x 0.85 incremental = $214,400 net new revenue (mid). Gross profit at 22% = $47,200. Low: 124 account-months (20 by Oct) x 4.33 = 537 x $220 = $118,140 x 0.80 = $94,500. High: 330 account-months (50 by Oct) x 4.33 = 1,429 x $300 = $428,700 x 0.85 = $364,400.
mathRunRate: Year 2 (Nov 2027-Oct 2028): accounts grow from 34 to ~52, so 44 average active x $330/week x 50 weeks = $726,000 gross x 0.85 incremental = $617,100 net new revenue, with gross profit at 22% = $135,800. Range: low 30 x $280 x 50 x 0.80 = $336,000; high 55 x $380 x 50 x 0.85 = $888,250. Against J&W's own year-2 costs of ~$78,000 (~$5,300/month plus 8 more freezers), contribution is about +$58,000 before plant fixed-cost absorption and member-code DTC sales.
mathNotes: Margin: at Pro, cooked food keeps ~31% after the 20% discount (from 45%) and cases ~21% after 8% off (from ~27%). A 65/35 cooked/case mix gives ~27-28% before Elite discounts, credits, shrink and mix risk. We plan on the model's 22%. Freezers, van time and staff are counted separately in costs.

Incrementality 0.85: most volume is new (a gym freezer sells to people who would not place a $100 route order), but some trainers and gym owners already buy cases at retail and will move to partner pricing. The Application Checker flags existing customers. J&W's existing informal restaurant and trade accounts are not counted.

Funnel to ~40 gross wins in year 1: ~2,000 businesses contacted along the route corridors x ~4% reply (Apollo SMB test 4.2%) = ~80, plus ~60 inbound from Instagram (30K), the store and trainer referrals = ~140 conversations, ~80 tasting trays, ~50% tasting-to-account = ~40 wins, less ~6 churned = 34 active.

Pool: ~2,000 GTA gyms and clubs (ESTIMATE from 4,195 Ontario establishments, IBISWorld), 59 Ontario CrossFit affiliates, ~31,460 fitness instructors and trainers in the Toronto region (Job Bank), ~8-12K independent trainers (ESTIMATE). 52 accounts is a small slice of this.
Sanity check: the year-2 run-rate is ~25% of J&W's $2.5M mid-case revenue and needs ~940 extra cooked meals and ~50 butcher cases a week. Confirm plant capacity first.

J&W's own costs: year 1 is ~$26,000 setup + ~$3,400/month Dec-Oct + ~$1,600 in Nov = ~$65,000, against $47,200 gross profit, so about -$18,000 in year 1 (mostly freezers). Year 2 is ~$78,000 against $135,800, so about +$58,000. This is a volume and plant-utilisation play, not a high-margin one.
Upside not counted: member-code DTC sales. Example: 44 partners x 3 member orders/month x $130 x 12 = ~$206,000 a year at 45% margin. Excluded to avoid double counting with Plays 1 and 6.
Partner economics: a gym selling 48 meals a week from a loaned freezer pays $577.06 at Pro and takes in $721.32 at web price, so it keeps ~$144/week (~$7,200/year) with no equipment cost.
Kept distinct: offices and employer-funded meals are Play 4, team fundraisers are Play 7 and consumer subscriptions are Play 1. Here a business buys to resell, or a team buys for its own athletes.

agentNeeds.name: Partner Scout (B2B prospecting agent)
agentNeeds.job: Builds target lists of gyms, CrossFit boxes, clinics, supplement shops, fight gyms and teams along the GTA 1-4 route corridors (Google Maps, websites, Clay enrichment). Scores fit, drafts personal outreach with a free tasting-tray offer, books tastings and follows up. Runs a CASL check on every message. Lucas approves each sequence.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view, AI drafts: outreach email to Birchmount Strength Co. with a CASL check line and Approve / Edit / Skip.

agentNeeds.name: Application Checker (onboarding and credit agent)
agentNeeds.job: Reads each application, checks the business is real (website, Google listing, address), maps it to a route day, suggests a tier and starter order, flags existing retail customers (for incrementality), and drafts the welcome email and price list. The owner approves tier and terms. Net-15 only after 4 paid orders.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Customer view: the instant AI pre-check card after Send application. Team view: Applications queue with AI notes and Approve as suggested / Change tier / Decline.

agentNeeds.name: Par Level Planner (partner reorder agent)
agentNeeds.job: Each Friday, uses the partner's freezer count (typed or photo), four weeks of sell-through and the season (January rush, summer dip, team season) to draft next week's standing order per partner and suggest par changes. The partner approves by Sunday; nothing ships without approval.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Partner portal (demo): Suggested order for Wednesday table with on hand, sold last week and suggested quantities. Team view: par-change draft for Brimley Barbell Club.

agentNeeds.name: Production & Route Planner (shared with the production forecast and route agents)
agentNeeds.job: Rolls approved partner orders into Monday's cook, portion and vacuum-pack sheet and the raw-material order, checks plant load against capacity (alert at 90%), and slots partner drops into GTA 1-4 routes with the dispatcher.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view, Production and route impact: +180 pre-set meals, 8 chicken cases, partner stops by route day and a plant-load meter.

agentNeeds.name: Label & Claims Checker
agentNeeds.job: Builds 'Fuelled by J&W at [partner]' co-branded labels from J&W's master recipe file (ingredients, allergens, net weight, best-before, plant details) and blocks health or disease claims (for example GLP-1 or diabetes) in partner copy. A person signs off every new label.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Customer view: live label preview in Your name on the label. Team view: a draft with 'great for GLP-1 patients' removed.

agentNeeds.name: Partner Receivables agent
agentNeeds.job: Issues net-15 invoices from approved orders, reconciles payments, sends polite reminders at 3 and 7 days overdue, and recommends pausing a standing order at 30 days, which the owner approves.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team view: Receivables aging buckets, DSO and a reminder draft to Harbour & Hill Nutrition. Partner portal: invoice list.

agentNeeds.name: Partner desk chat (shared Butler Concierge, partner mode)
agentNeeds.job: Answers partner questions on minimums, tiers, freezer loans, cut-offs, labels and member codes from the approved price list and agreement, and hands any pricing exception to Lucas.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Chat 'Ask the Butler · Partner desk' with the scripted partner rules.

assumptions: Build in November 2026, first drops in December 2026 (startMonth 2).
Mid ramp to 34 active accounts by Oct 2027 and ~44 on average in year 2, with ~2.5% monthly account churn.
Average weekly order $260 in year 1 and $330 in year 2; 50 ordering weeks in year 2.
Account mix by Oct 2027 (ESTIMATE): 12 gyms and fight gyms, 9 trainers and coaching studios, 5 clinics, 5 supplement and health shops, 3 teams and academies.
Concept discounts off J&W web prices: cooked 15/20/25%, butcher cases 5/8/10%; the first 10 founding partners get Pro pricing for 12 months.
Blended gross margin 22% (model-assumptions.md); incremental factor 0.85 (model range 0.75-0.85).
Owned-route cost ~$10 per added partner stop (model $8-14); about 12 minutes of driver time per stop.
Loaned glass-door reach-in freezer ~$1,800 including wrap (ESTIMATE); 10 in year 1, ~8 more in year 2.
Account lead at $30/h loaded, 10 h/week in year 1 and ~15 h/week in year 2.
Partners resell at J&W's web price or higher, in person only; members order online with the partner's code.
All partners are in Ontario, on the existing GTA 1-4 routes or picking up at Brimley Rd.
Member-code DTC sales, offices (Play 4), fundraisers (Play 7) and J&W's existing informal trade accounts are excluded from this play's revenue.
risks: Thin margin: at 22%, a few off-list deals wipe out the profit. Only tier prices in the portal; any exception needs the owner's approval.
Cannibalisation: existing case-buying trainers may switch to partner pricing. The Partner tier needs a business and $150+ a week, and the Application Checker flags existing customers.

Resale labelling: food resold by a third party needs full prepackaged labels (ingredients, allergens, net weight, best-before, dealer name and address, and a Nutrition Facts table unless an exemption applies; bilingual rules apply). J&W publishes no nutrition panels today. Budget the analysis and confirm the rules with a labelling consultant before the first freezer goes out.
Cold chain in someone else's freezer: require -18 C or colder, fit a Wi-Fi sensor, pull stock after any excursion, and assign responsibility in the partner agreement.
Credit risk on net-15: card only for the first four orders; reminders from day 3; the owner pauses accounts at 30 days.
Plant capacity and staff: year 2 needs ~940 extra meals a week. The planner flags load at 90%. Confirm headroom before signing Elite accounts.
Health claims at clinics: no medical or GLP-1 claims on labels or in copy. The clinic's dietitian chooses the menu, and J&W shares ingredient lists.
Provincial licence: the plant is Ontario-inspected, so partners must be in Ontario. The current routes already are.
Growing faster than service: Icon's 1.7 Trustpilot score shows what happens when a brand scales past its delivery capacity. Pace new accounts to route and plant capacity and protect J&W's 4.8 stars.
Year 1 is roughly break-even to slightly negative (~-$18K) after freezer capex. The owners must be comfortable investing for a ~$58K/year contribution from year 2 plus the plant-utilisation benefit.
who: Lucas (or a new B2B account lead): 8-10 h/week in year 1 on applications, tastings, account calls and approving agent drafts, rising to ~15 h/week in year 2. Production lead: +3 h/week folding partner orders into the Monday cook sheet (extra cook and pack labour sits inside the margin; expect ~1 more cook/packer FTE by mid year 2). Drivers: +3 h/week by spring 2027 and +6 h/week by Oct 2027 on the existing GTA 1-4 routes. Bill or Steven: ~1 h/week approving tiers, terms, exceptions and new labels.

costs.note: J&W's own costs, excluding Minastech's fee. Setup (year 1): 10 loaned glass-door reach-in freezers with J&W wrap at ~$1,800 each ($18,000, ESTIMATE; refurbished units could save a third), nutrition-facts analysis and resale label templates for ~20 SKUs ($2,500), thermal label printer and stock ($700), 10 Wi-Fi freezer temperature sensors ($500), counter cards, QR stands, sell sheets and member flyers ($1,300), CanFitPro Toronto 2027 booth and samples ($3,000, ESTIMATE). Monthly, year-1 average Dec-Oct: account lead 10 h/week x $30 ($1,300), ~90 added route stops x ~$10 ($900), tasting trays for 4 new accounts x ~$90 ($360), software: Clay Launch $185 + wholesale pricing app ~$100 + Claude API ~$25 ($310), labels and flyers ($150), ads to gym owners and trainers ($250), bad-debt reserve ~0.5% of revenue ($100). Year 2 runs at ~$5,300/month plus ~8 more freezers ($14,400).

prototype.concept: A partner-facing wholesale front door that J&W does not have today: who it serves, tiered Concept pricing on real J&W products, a shoppable partner catalogue with case packs, a co-branded label studio, and a two-minute application with an instant AI pre-check. A 'Partner portal (demo)' mode shows a signed-in gym approving an AI-drafted standing order, with invoices, member-code results and freezer status. The JW team view shows the applications queue, AI drafts to approve, partner accounts, production and route impact, and receivables. Every flow ends in the framework's demo checkout on J&W's real routes. File: site/prototypes/02-pro-partner-portal.html, JWC.init({ n: 2 }).
prototype.wow: Build your freezer: the visitor types a business name, picks a city and drags a 'meals a week' slider. A CSS glass-door freezer fills shelf by shelf with real J&W product photos, its header reads 'FUELLED BY J&W AT {NAME}', and a receipt shows the tier, what they pay ($577.06 at Pro for 48 meals), what members pay ($721.32), what they keep ($144.26 a week, about $7,213 a year) and their route day ('GTA 2 · Wednesday · order by Sunday'). One tap, 'Order this freezer fill', puts it in the cart.

design.inspiredBy: Icon Meals' wholesale page structure (proof, segments, plant story, shoppable grid with macros and steppers; white sticky header, full-bleed hero with dark overlay, alternating light canvas and dark bands, uppercase tracked headings), rebuilt in J&W laurel navy with butcher-shop warmth. Partner portal patterns borrow from B2B dashboards. No Icon text, logos or photos, and no fake partner-logo wall.

design.layout: Mobile-first single column with a 16px gutter, max width 1160px. White sticky sub-header under the concept bar: J&W logo (../assets/img/jw-logo.jpg) + 'PRO PARTNERS', anchor links, and a two-way switch 'Become a partner | Partner portal (demo)'. Hero is two-column on desktop (copy left, freezer teaser right) over ../assets/img/meals.jpg with a #0E2340 overlay at ~70%. Sections alternate canvas and deep-navy bands. Cards have a 16px radius and soft shadow. Barlow Condensed 600/700 uppercase with wide tracking for headings and big numbers. Tables become stacked cards under 640px. Sticky order bar at the bottom on mobile, sitting above the framework dock. Tap targets 44px. No horizontal scroll at 375px. Google Fonts: family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700.
design.tone: Plain, confident and trade-friendly. Numbers first. Talks like a family butcher who knows gym owners. Short sentences, Canadian spelling, no hype.

Partner pricing by the case, standing weekly drops on our own routes, and a freezer on loan once you're rolling.' Buttons: 'Apply in 2 minutes' (solid navy) and 'Build your freezer' (white outline). sections.name: S2 Proof strip
sections.purpose: Real J&W proof in place of a partner-logo wall.
sections.content: Four chips: '4.8★ · 611 Google reviews' · 'Ontario-inspected plant since 2008' · 'No added salt, sugar or oil in Meal Butler food' · 'Family butchers since 1995 · wholesale roots to 1973'.

sections.name: S3 WHO WE SUPPLY
sections.purpose: Audience router: six segment cards, each loading a real starter order.
sections.content: Intro: 'Six kinds of partners, one kitchen. Pick yours and we'll load a starter order.' Each card has a 'See starter order' button (loads preset into cart/catalogue, scrolls there, toast 'Starter order for {segment} loaded. Change anything.'). 1 'Gyms & CrossFit boxes': 'A front-desk freezer of grab-and-go meals. Members buy after class. You keep the margin.' Preset: 48-Meal Freezer Restock. 2 'Personal trainers & coaches': 'Order your clients' week in one case and hand it over at the session.' Preset: Trainer Client Week x 3. 3 'Physio, dietitian & weight-loss clinics': 'Smaller portions, high protein, nothing added. Your dietitian picks the menu.' Preset: Clinic Small-Portion 12-Pack x 2 + Breakfast Box of 24. 4 'Supplement & health shops': 'Put fast-moving protein next to the tubs. We restock every week.' Preset: Mixed 24-Meal Case + Breakfast Box of 24. 5 'Boxing, MMA & fight gyms': 'Portions weighed to the ounce, for athletes who count every gram.' Preset: Fight Camp 12-Pack x 2 + 1 Case of Portioned Chicken Breast (4 kg, 4 oz). 6 'Teams & academies': 'Travel-day and camp meals, invoiced to the club.' Preset: Mixed 24-Meal Case x 2 + Premium Chicken Burgers 25-pack. Small print on card 6: 'Raising money for your team? Ask us about our fundraiser program.'

sections.name: S4 BUILD YOUR FREEZER (wow)
sections.purpose: Make the partner economics tangible and personal in one interaction.
sections.content: Deep-navy band. Intro: 'Tell us who you are. We'll fill a freezer, put your name on it and show you what it earns.' Inputs: 'Your business name' (placeholder 'Brimley Barbell Club'), 'City' (select from JWC.cities(), default Scarborough), 'Meals a week' slider 12-120 step 12 (default 48), mix chips 'Balanced · Lean · Fighter · Clinic' (Balanced = 48-Meal Restock mix; Lean = Turkey, Tilapia, Tenders, Souvlaki; Fighter = Tenders 4 oz + Teriyaki 4 oz; Clinic = the three 4 oz meals). Output: CSS glass-door freezer, 4 shelves filling with JWC.img(p,200) thumbnails, header 'FUELLED BY J&W AT {NAME}'. Receipt: 'Your tier: Pro · 20% off cooked food' / 'You pay: $577.06 a week' / 'Members pay (our web price): $721.32' / 'You keep: $144.26 a week · about $7,213 a year' / 'Your drop: GTA 2 · Wednesday · order by Sunday' (from JWC.routesFor(city); pickup if none) / 'Freezer: on loan from J&W' if ≥ $300 a week, else 'Freezer: on loan once you average $300 a week'. Buttons: 'Order this freezer fill' (adds mix at tier price to JWC.cart, opens cart) and 'Apply with this plan' (pre-fills S10). Small print: 'Web prices from jwfoods.com. Partner discounts are Concept pricing. Margins are estimates. Demo only.'

sections.name: S5 HOW IT WORKS
sections.purpose: Four plain steps from application to selling.
sections.content: 1 'Apply': 'Two minutes. A real person replies within one business day.' 2 'Taste': 'We drop a free tasting tray of 24 portions on your route day, so your members try before you buy.' 3 'Set your standing order': 'Pick your products and your route day. Change it any time before Sunday night.' 4 'We drop it. You sell it.': 'Standing orders of $150 or more drop free. Average $300 a week and the freezer is on us.'

sections.name: S6 PARTNER PRICING
sections.purpose: Transparent tiered pricing (the thing Icon never published), labelled Concept.
sections.content: Sub: 'Simple tiers, set by your average weekly order over four weeks. Concept pricing for this proposal.' Toggle 'Cooked meals | Butcher cases'. Partner: 'From $150 a week' · '15% off Meal Butler cooked food' / '5% off butcher cases' · 'Free drop on your route day' · 'Member code for your clients' · 'Net-15 invoices after 4 paid orders'. Pro (highlighted): 'From $300 a week' · '20% off cooked' / '8% off cases' · 'Everything in Partner' · 'Reach-in freezer on loan' · 'Your name on the label'. Elite (brass): 'From $600 a week' · '25% off cooked' / '10% off cases' · 'Everything in Pro' · 'First pick of production slots' · 'Quarterly menu tasting with our kitchen'. Founding banner: 'Founding partners: the first 10 accounts get Pro pricing from their first order, for 12 months.' Rule: 'Sell at our web price or higher, never lower. Your members will never find it cheaper on jwfoods.com.' Example: 'Jerk Chicken, Green Beans & Sweet Potato (6 oz) is $14.99 on our site. Pro partners pay $11.99 and keep $3.00 a meal.'

sections.name: S7 PARTNER CATALOGUE
sections.purpose: Shoppable B2B order builder with tier prices, macros (est.), case packs and a minimum check.
sections.content: Sub: 'Real J&W products at your tier price. Order by Sunday for next week's drop.' 'Preview prices as: Partner | Pro | Elite' (auto from order, overridable). Tabs: 'Meal cases (Concept)' · 'Pre-set meals' · 'Proteins by the portion' · 'Breakfast' · 'Butcher cases'. Card: photo, name, 'Web $14.99 · Pro $11.99', macro strip 'est. kcal · P · C · F' via JWC.macros, pack selector on pre-set meals 'Single | 12-pack | 24-pack' (Concept), −/+ stepper, 'Concept' badge on meal cases. Sticky bar: '{n} meals · {m} cases · {tier} · ${total}' + 'Review order'; below minimum: 'Minimum is 12 meals or 1 case.' Crossing a threshold: toast 'You've reached Pro pricing: 20% off cooked food.' and re-price. Tier rule: highest tier whose threshold the order still meets when priced at that tier (Elite total ≥ $600, else Pro ≥ $300, else Partner ≥ $150, else web price with note 'Partner pricing starts at $150 an order'); founding flag forces at least Pro. 'Review order' modal: switch 'Make this my standing weekly order' (on), then JWC.checkout.

sections.name: S8 YOUR NAME ON THE LABEL
sections.purpose: Co-branded label studio plus member code, showing J&W stays the named maker.
sections.content: Sub: 'Pro and Elite partners get co-branded labels at no charge. Our plant details stay on every pack, so your members know exactly who made it.' Inputs: 'Name on the label' (default 'Brimley Barbell Club'), 'Member code' (auto first word + '10', e.g. BRIMLEY10, editable), product select (Jerk 6 oz / Souvlaki 6 oz / Egg White Bites). Label preview on a vacuum-pack mock: 'FUELLED BY J&W AT BRIMLEY BARBELL CLUB' · product name · 'Net weight and best-before print here' · 'Ingredients and allergens print here from J&W's recipe file' · 'Keep frozen. Thaw overnight in the fridge, then microwave 60-90 seconds.' · 'Made by J&W Foods Inc., 2201 Brimley Rd, Unit 1, Scarborough ON · Ontario-inspected plant' · QR block + 'Members: use BRIMLEY10 for 10% off your first order at jwfoods.com'. Explainer: 'Your members get 10% off their first online order. You earn 5% of what they spend online, as J&W credit, for 12 months.' Buttons: 'Copy member code' (toast 'Copied BRIMLEY10 (demo)') and 'Add labels to my next order' (toast 'Labels added. We print them with your next order.'; adds a note to the next checkout).

sections.name: S9 THE PLANT BEHIND THE PARTNERSHIP
sections.purpose: The Icon-style plant story, told with J&W's real heritage.
sections.content: Deep-navy band with ../assets/img/souvlaki.jpg and a white text card: 'We butcher, cook, weigh and vacuum-seal everything under one roof at 2201 Brimley Rd. We've been an Ontario-inspected plant since 2008, and our family has supplied restaurants since George Trougakos started Advance Food Products in 1973. Our chicken is air-chilled, grain-fed and raised in Ontario. Meal Butler food has no added salt, sugar or oil.' Stats: 'Since 1995' · '6 weekly routes' · '4.8★ from 611 Google reviews' · '4 kg cases in 4, 5, 6 or 8 oz portions'. Review line: 'I recommend all of my clients.' · a personal trainer, Google review.

sections.name: S11 FAQ
sections.content: Accordion. 'What's the minimum order?' 12 cooked meals or one butcher case. Standing orders of $150 or more drop free on your route day. / 'When do you deliver?' On our weekly routes: Tuesday Durham, Wednesday Toronto and Mississauga, Thursday Halton and Hamilton, Friday York and Peel. Order by Sunday for the next week. Pickup at Brimley Rd is always free. / 'How do I pay?' By card for your first four orders. After that, approved partners get net-15 invoices. / 'How does the freezer loan work?' Average $300 a week for eight weeks and we lend you a branded reach-in freezer with a temperature sensor. We own it and service it, and we take it back if you stop ordering. You supply the outlet. / 'How long does the food keep?' Everything is flash-frozen and vacuum-sealed, and each pack carries a best-before date. Keep it at −18°C or colder. / 'Can I sell online?' In person only. Your members can order from us online with your member code, and you earn credit. / 'Do labels show allergens and nutrition?' Every partner pack carries ingredients, allergens, net weight, best-before and our plant details. Nutrition facts are being added for partner products. / 'Can you deliver outside Ontario?' Not yet. Our plant is provincially inspected, so we sell within Ontario.

chat.name: Ask the Butler · Partner desk
chat.greeting: Hi, I'm the partner desk for J&W Pro Partners. Ask me about minimums, pricing tiers, the freezer loan or how drops work on your route day.
suggestions: How does the freezer loan work?
What margin would my gym make?
Can my clinic patients use this?

rules.reply: The minimum is 12 cooked meals or one butcher case per order. Standing orders of $150 or more drop free on your route day.

Three tiers, set by your average weekly order over four weeks. Partner from $150: 15% off cooked food, 5% off cases. Pro from $300: 20% and 8%, plus a loaned freezer and your name on the label. Elite from $600: 25% and 10%. Concept pricing for this demo.
Average $300 a week for eight weeks and we lend you a branded reach-in freezer with a temperature sensor. We own it and service it. You supply the outlet. Founding partners can get one from day one.
Your first four orders go on a card. After that, approved partners get net-15 invoices. We send a friendly reminder if one runs late.
Pro and Elite partners get 'Fuelled by J&W at [your name]' labels at no charge. Every label keeps our ingredients, allergens, best-before and plant details.
Every partner gets a member code. Your members get 10% off their first online order, and you earn 5% of what they spend online, as J&W credit, for 12 months.
Sell at our web price or higher. Example: Jerk Chicken, Green Beans & Sweet Potato (6 oz) is $14.99 online. Pro partners pay $11.99 and keep $3.00 a meal. 48 meals a week is about $144 a week.

Clinics often stock our 4 oz pre-set meals and egg-white bites: high protein, smaller portions, no added salt, sugar or oil. We don't make medical claims, so your dietitian chooses the menu. We'll share full ingredient lists.
Teams order travel-day and camp meals, invoiced to the club and dropped on your route day or picked up at Brimley Rd. Raising money instead? Ask about our fundraiser program.
The application takes two minutes. We reply within one business day and drop a free tasting tray of 24 portions on your route day.
